description: List the cities of a country that have active listings, busiest first, with escort and venue counts and each city's escortfox.com link. Use the city slug as `city` in search_listings, and the city's region as `country` where it differs from the country code (US states, e.g. "US-CA").

country.description: Required. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "DE"), or a city's region code where the site splits a country by state (e.g. "US-CA"). Get valid values from list_countries / list_cities.

name: list_cities
title: List cities
